name: GET /api/leadflow/inbox - one thread across every channel
description:
The unified inbox.

ONE ORDERING KEY, normalised upstream across providers. Ordering by each provider's own timestamp interleaves them wrongly whenever two clocks disagree, and an inbox showing a reply above the message it answers is worse than one that is slightly stale.

An unreachable conversation service reports the thread as UNKNOWN rather than empty: an empty inbox and an unreachable one look identical, and only one of them means there is nothing to do.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
